suites.name: trust-plumbing
suites.detail: kit/v1 rule: depends on github.com/mitstack-eu/block-kit at or above the floor v0.4.0, operator.go imports github.com/mitstack-eu/block-kit/handler, no kit-owned symbol redeclared, manifest.yaml present

suites.name: contract
suites.detail: kit/v1 rule: the kit owns the webhook-contract goldens; operator.go imports github.com/mitstack-eu/block-kit/handler

suites.name: secret-safety
suites.detail: TestNoSecretLeak (+ the /logs variant where /logs is served) passes

suites.name: teardown
suites.detail: kit/v1 rule: TestUnsubscribeDeletes* proves unsubscribe deletes what subscribe created; the kit's handler asks the provider again after a delete

suites.name: resources
suites.detail: TestDeclaredResources proves the block's 8 declared resources hold the guards that ran: tagging, observe-asks-the-provider, replacement, absence-after-unsubscribe, required-outputs

suites.name: deliverable
suites.detail: own Dockerfile exists and assumes no monorepo build context

suites.name: manifest
suites.detail: the mitstack/v1beta manifest parses; no --base-manifest given, so spec.version was not compared
